name: Altfinstermünz
kurzbeschreibung: The historic **Zollburg** fortress, perched along the **Via Claudia Augusta**, overlooks the deep **Innschlucht** gorge and houses a museum dedicated to trade history.
beschreibung: Altfinstermünz – The historic customs fortress of **Altfinstermünz** in **Pfunds** uniquely blends history, art, and Tyrolean tradition. Perched above the deep **Innschlucht** gorge along the ancient **Via Claudia Augusta**, it houses a museum dedicated to the region’s trading history. Whether you visit alone, with family, or in a group, **Altfinstermünz** offers an enriching cultural experience for all ages. Audio guides and informative panels allow you to explore the exhibition at your own pace. Nestled within the charming old town of **Pfunds**, the fortress seamlessly integrates into the historic urban landscape. Nearby attractions and cozy cafés invite you to linger. A visit to **Altfinstermünz** is rewarding year-round and is sure to leave a lasting impression.
